svg.title: Development feedback ends before final outcomes
svg.desc: The eight development tasks support a loop of pilot runs, inspection, and revisions. Before final evaluation, freeze the tested code, policies, model configuration, budgets, fixtures, graders, and metrics in a manifest. The sixteen final tasks are validated with model-free controls and identified in the manifest. A launcher validates that manifest before final agent trials. Final outcomes feed the report, not changes to the frozen study.
